$schema_comment: Source of truth for Hostinger Node.js Web App hPanel settings. Hostinger does not auto-apply this file — copy these values into Deploy / Build settings.
warnings: Never set application type / framework to vite — Hostinger Vite is static-only and will not start dist/server.mjs.
Never leave entryFile empty — Express must run so Vite dist is served through Express (API + SPA fallback).
Confirm Runtime Logs show SERVER_READY and PORT_LISTENING after each deploy.
requiredEnv: Firebase Admin credentials as required by the server
